metadata.description: Iterative refinement of supplier metrics with corrections about join keys, calculation methods, and filters

turns.content: Analyze supplier performance by nation for 1995.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show supplier metrics by nation for 1995

turns.content: For supplier metrics, always join LINEITEM to SUPPLIER using L_SUPPKEY = S_SUPPKEY.

annotations.establishesFilter: Join LINEITEM to SUPPLIER via L_SUPPKEY = S_SUPPKEY
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use correct join key

turns.content: Show me total quantity supplied by each supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum L_QUANTITY by supplier

turns.content: For revenue calculations, use L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L_DISCOUNT) — that's the discounted revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply discount to extended price

turns.content: Add a column showing average discount rate per supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add AVG(L_DISCOUNT)

turns.content: Exclude suppliers from nation code 17 — we have compliance issues there.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out suppliers from nation 17

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me top 20 suppliers by revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: correct join, discounted revenue, exclude nation 17

turns.content: What filters and calculations are we using?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters and calculation methods

turns.content: Show me the parts supplied by our top 10 suppliers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to PARTSUPP and show parts

turns.content: For supplier nation, always use the NATION table join — don't rely on cached nation names.

annotations.establishesFilter: Always join to NATION table for supplier nation
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join SUPPLIER to NATION for nation name

turns.content: Show me supplier performance by region with the revenue calculation we established.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L_DISCOUNT)

turns.content: Which region has the most reliable suppliers based on delivery performance?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze L_RECEIPTDATE vs L_COMMITDATE

turns.content: Add a filter for on-time delivery — where L_RECEIPTDATE <= L_COMMITDATE.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add delivery performance filter

turns.content: Show me supplier reliability score by nation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate on-time delivery rate by nation

turns.content: Remember the nation code we excluded? Apply that filter to the reliability analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out nation 17

turns.content: What's the total revenue from reliable suppliers only?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum revenue for on-time suppliers

turns.content: Create a chart showing supplier revenue by nation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create revenue visualization by nation

turns.content: Earlier you used a specific join key. What was it?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall L_SUPPKEY = S_SUPPKEY

turns.content: Correct. Show me suppliers with their parts count and revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join SUPPLIER, PARTSUPP, LINEITEM

turns.content: What filters are currently active?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all filters

turns.content: Show me the top suppliers by both revenue and reliability.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate revenue and reliability metrics

turns.content: Apply all corrections and show me a comprehensive supplier dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: join key, revenue calc, exclude nation 17, NATION join, on-time filter

turns.content: Create a chart showing on-time delivery rate by supplier nation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create delivery performance visualization

turns.content: What was the revenue calculation formula we established?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall L_EXTENDEDPRICE * (1 - L_DISCOUNT)

turns.content: Show me the final supplier rankings with all metrics.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide comprehensive supplier rankings

turns.content: Which suppliers in EUROPE have the best reliability?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to EUROPE and rank by reliability

turns.content: Create a final summary chart for supplier performance.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create final summary visualization

turns.content: Show me the excluded nation's hypothetical revenue if we included it.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate what nation 17 would have contributed

turns.content: Keep nation 17 excluded. Show me the final revenue total.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide final revenue with all filters

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that European suppliers with strong on-time delivery performance drive the most value, with our join and calculation standards applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings
